candidates.description: This vector represents sequential numbers in the one-hundred-eighties range.
This vector represents small integers expressed in both Arabic numerals and Roman numerals.

This feature vector activates strongly on character fragments, punctuation, and numerals from various non-English scripts, particularly Devanagari and accented Latin characters, representing multilingual tokenization noise.
This vector represents sequential integers and numerical values, particularly small numbers and Roman numerals.
This vector activates for words, name fragments, and syllables in multilingual contexts, particularly involving Hindi and English text segments.
This vector represents a mixture of noisy multilingual subword fragments, primarily Hindi script characters and numerical tokens, without a single cohesive semantic theme.
These tokens represent common Hindi word suffixes and sub-word morphs.
This vector represents sequential integers within the one-hundred-nineties range.
This vector activates for Hindi character fragments and vowel modifiers occurring within Devanagari text.
These tokens represent characters and character combinations from the Devanagari script used for writing languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
